crime: Every school morning, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother pinned her left sleeve into her pocket so that no one would have to see the curled hand inside.

In the prison, one girl made shadow animals in the projector beam every evening while the prisoners watched from the recreation room. Her big hands made the best shadows, and afterward she stayed by the lounge fire practising the next animal until lockup. Every night she saved a seat at the front for {WITCH_NAME}, who sat at the back with her left hand in her sleeve.

One evening the girl drew that curled hand out of its sleeve and lifted it into the beam as the swan's other wing. Its shadow filled the screen in front of everyone. "Tomorrow you'll be my other wing again," she said.

Before lockup, {WITCH_NAME} went to her by the lounge fire and took her left hand, as if to learn the wing. With that touch she traded it for her own curled one. Two whole hands, at last. She closed them both round the girl's throat beside the fireplace and held on until she was still. Then she gave the dead girl back her own left hand, took back the curled one, and went down to her cell before the doors were locked.

At six, the prisoners found the girl dead by the cold fireplace, the marks of two whole hands closed round her throat. In the trial court, {WITCH_NAME} held out her bare curled hand. It could not close. Two whole hands had strangled the girl, hers could not, and every living girl's hands were her own. The prisoners ruled her out.

Then one prisoner pointed to the finger marks. The left hand's reached round to the nape of the girl's neck; the right's stopped short. The left hand had been the dead girl's own big hand, worn by {WITCH_NAME} that night and given back after.
fields.epitaph: The one night she had two whole hands, she spent them on the girl who wanted the curled one.
fields.epithet: The Girl with One Hand Pinned Away
execution: A white screen rises in a projector beam. Her left arm is bound bare along the screen, and a pin as long as a spear is levelled at her heart. The pin drives through her chest and into the screen. Before the spectators, the projector lights her bare left hand spread across the screen, the fingers she always kept curled pinned open to every eye. She hangs still on the pin, the beam still on her hand.

magic.name: Even Trade
magic.text: She can swap any feature between two people she touches, herself included.
